title: Preprocessing contract of one benchmark entry

entry.description: detector or method name as on the leaderboard

subset.description: table the entry belongs to (e.g. U, M, both)

audited_commit.description: commit whose code this record describes

results_commit.description: commit of the code that produced the entry's published results; null if not established

scope.description: unit over which statistics are computed

statistics_from.description: data the statistics come from (window, training part, whole series, ...)

fit_score_mismatch.description: whether fitting and scoring DIFFER in transform or statistics: starts with 'yes' (they differ), 'no' (they do not), 'n/a' (one pass) or 'unclear', then the audit's explanation
